skills.super-board: Orchestrator: plans waves, runs Build → QA → Review, merges when green.
skills.super-collect: Finds problems (Sentry, PostHog, issues, PRs, architecture) and files verified Backlog cards.
skills.ui-refine-loop: Critique → refine loop that polishes one page or component.
skills.visual: One HTML page: branch recap, plan, or codebase map with diagrams.
skills.git-sync: Commit per logical change, merge-pull, push without force, report.
skills.super-paper2code: Optional research capability: generates paper-to-project candidates for Builder integration.

skills.super-build: Builder lane: worktree, smallest safe change, tests, draft PR.
skills.super-qa: Tester lane: evidence, test-gap check, screenshots, or bounce to Build.
skills.super-review: Reviewer lane: own hypotheses, remembers prior findings, merge gate.
